channel.title: Quest Log
channel.description: One guy talking about the audiobooks he can't stop listening to — LitRPG, progression fantasy, and whatever's next.

item.title: Why Dungeon Crawler Carl Is My Favorite Series
item.description: Finished the whole series. Slightly let down by the latest book, but book 2 is still the best — and I met Matt Dinniman and Jeff Hays at a signing.

item.title: Honorable Mentions: The Dark Tower, Super Powereds & Scythe
item.description: Three series outside my usual LitRPG lane that stuck with me anyway.

item.title: Mistborn: Burning Metal, Breaking Empires
item.description: Sanderson's heist-driven trilogy might be the most purely fun Cosmere has been yet. 9.5/10.

item.title: The Sunlit Man: Sanderson in a Hurry
item.description: A fast, self-contained Cosmere standalone about a man on the run from a killer sun. 7/10.

item.title: Ranking My Favorite Audiobook Narrators
item.description: A bad narrator can kill a great book. A great one can save a mediocre one. Jeff Hays sits at the top.

item.title: Sanderson on Audio: Different Itch, Same Addiction
item.description: The magic systems are insane, the books are massive, and audiobooks are the only reason I've actually finished any of them.

item.title: 1% Lifesteal: Weak Ability, Brutal Growth
item.description: A weak-sounding ability, a brutal post-apocalyptic world, and a growth system with real moral weight. 8/10.

item.title: 12 Miles Below: Cool World, Middling Payoff
item.description: A frozen apocalypse and a living-machine underground maze — great setting, didn't hook me on character. 6/10.

item.title: Warformed: Stormweaver — If You Liked Victor of Tucson
item.description: Academy training, tournament arcs, and grounded power growth. 7.5/10.

item.title: Other Progression Fantasy Series I Want to Try
item.description: He Who Fights with Monsters, The Primal Hunter, Cradle, and a few more on my list.

item.title: Victor of Tucson: Finished, and It's One of My Favorites
item.description: 8.9/10. Loved the main character, the progression, the fights. Already excited for the next book.
